Subject: Clarification regarding your recent email

Dear [Name],

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to seek clarification on a few points in your recent email to ensure I provide the most accurate and helpful response.

First, could you please specify which documents from our previous discussion you would like me to forward? If there are specific files or topics you are most interested in, please let me know.

Second, regarding your request for my thoughts on how to proceed, could you elaborate on which specific aspects or areas of the project you would like my input on? This will help me tailor my feedback to your current priorities.

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to your guidance.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
